availability.note: toyota.com.au configurator not fetchable (403 at the sweep; Toyota AU news page 403 again today). CarExpert 2026 spec page lists this grade with a current before-on-roads and drive-away price; CarExpert 29 Sep 2026 news lists XSE FWD, XSE AWD and GR Sport AWD as the PHEV grades currently on sale; Toyota dealer page https://www.sunshinetoyota.com.au/models/rav4 lists XSE PHEV 2WD/AWD and GR Sport PHEV AWD. GXL 2WD PHEV due Q1 2027, unpriced, not orderable.

listPrice.note: 'before on-road costs' in words on the CarExpert spec page (drive-away shown $63,900 (Sydney basis)); same figure 'before on-road costs' in CarExpert news 11 Nov 2025 (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2026-toyota-rav4-price-and-specs) and 29 Sep 2026 (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/cheaper-toyota-rav4-phev-coming-to-australia-in-2027), GoAuto 'Pricing excludes on-road costs', RACV 'plus on-road costs' with Victorian drive-away $65,158. App's computed Vic drive-away $62,191. No later change found; CarsGuide 12 Aug 2026 reports Toyota planning staged price rises into 2027 for RAV4 Hybrid/bZ4X/HiLux, PHEV not named.

batteryKwh.note: Usable not published anywhere found. 22.7 kWh is gross: ADAC lists it as 'Batteriekapazität brutto' with netto blank; Toyota UK tech specs give 22.7 kWh, 104 cells, 391 V (Toyota rule: unlabelled Toyota capacity is gross). Held 20.1 kept (88.5% of gross), in line with Toyota's ~88% usable share on the previous 18.1 kWh pack and sibling lexus-nx-phev (16.0 of 18.1). Same pack on all grades.

rangeKm.note: Toyota Australia's WLTP figure: GoAuto quotes 154 km NEDC / 121 km WLTP for the XSE 2WD; RACV and CarsGuide quote 121 km. The AU spec sheet's ADR figure is NEDC (154 km, https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/rav4/files/20260512_gto009809_rav4_spec_table.pdf), higher than WLTP, so rejected. European WLTP on the same 20-inch wheel is higher (137 km, ADAC); Toyota AU's lower WLTP figure used.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 20.1/121x100 = 16.61. No published EV-mode figure for the AU car; ADAC's 'Stromverbrauch' (12.2 kWh/100km) is a WLTP weighted quantity and was not used.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 655 L VDA for the PHEV (705 L for the hybrid), CarsGuide; CarExpert GR Sport review quotes Toyota's 655 L. VDA to the cargo cover. Toyota UK quotes 672 L 'rear seats in place' (UK car without the AU space-saver spare); ADAC lists 446 L, basis unclear.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Toyota UK PHEV tech specs: 'rear seats folded, up to tonneau cover' 1,189 L (to roof 1,690 L). Owner convention is to the cover / belt line. Held 1780 was a to-the-roof style figure. UK car's seats-up is 17 L larger than AU (no space-saver), so the AU folded figure may be slightly lower.

seats.note: Toyota AU spec table: seating capacity 5 (May 2026).

towKg.note: Toyota AU spec table braked towing: Plug-in Hybrid 2WD 800 kg, AWD 1500 kg (UK AWD is 2,000 kg; AU sheet governs).

warrantyYears.note: 5 years / unlimited km (RACV; CarExpert GR Sport review). Traction battery up to 10 years service-activated, not counted.

insuranceAnnual.note: Held judgement kept, prices unchanged. Anchors: mitsubishi-outlander-phev-es $1650 at $58,990 and aspire $1750 at $66,790; vw-tiguan-phev-150tsi-elegance $1750 at $64,590; toyota-bz4x-2wd $1620 at $55,990 and awd $1780 at $67,990. Stepped by grade price.

depreciationCurve.note: Toyota brand convention (owner rule: one curve per brand, check toyota-bz4x): same curve as toyota-bz4x rows refreshed 2026-11-26. Held rows used the mainstream default on XSE and 0.76/0.45 on GR Sport. RAV4 nameplate resale is historically strong, so this likely understates PHEV residuals.

combinedRangeKm.note: rangeKm 121 + 55 L tank / 5.2 L/100km x 100 (1057.7) = 1179. Tank 55 L from Toyota AU spec table and CarExpert spec page.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: ADAC 'Verbrauch kombiniert (WLTP) PHEV (Batterie leer)' 5,2 l/100km for the 2.5 Plug-in Hybrid Style FWD (200 kW) on 235/50R20, the AU wheel/tyre (CarExpert spec page). Same basis as siblings kia-sorento-phev, vw-tiguan-phev, mitsubishi-outlander-phev. Australian real-world flat-battery: CarExpert 5.6 (GR Sport), RACV 6.0. Held 6.0 was the RACV real-world figure.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Toyota AU spec table ADR 81/02 combined 0.7 L/100km for both PHEV drivelines, at or below 3.5.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green car = combined tailpipe CO2 120 g/km or less; CarExpert spec page (https://www.carexpert.com.au/toyota/rav4/2026-xse-2-5l-suv-fwd-electric-jsk5k8kw20251111) gives 16 g/km combined.
